decisions.reason: Because this camera is close to the core business, was given a dedicated market presentation, and the firm has slack in a growing high-R&D industry, its early results are likely to stay above or near aspiration levels so management would keep it.

As a modular camera line with several models and a dedicated page, Product B signals stronger commitment and fit with existing capabilities, making it unlikely that management would redeploy resources away from it within a year.

The sensor suite extends established capabilities into a related space need and was actively presented to the market, so under bounded rationality the firm would likely tolerate uncertainty and continue it unless clear underperformance emerged.

Although the miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is technologically adjacent, its weaker website presence suggests a more tentative commercialization, so it faces the highest review risk but would still more likely be retained given firm slack and strategic relevance.
